# Trip Pages Redesign Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Rebuild the 52 `/trip/<a>-to-<b>/` pages and the `/trip/` index as photo-led landing pages, and make every list price on them the engine's fare.

**Architecture:** Everything customer-facing is generated by `tools/generate-route-pages.mjs` (inline CSS, no shared-component blast radius). Photos come from a new per-place manifest. List prices are fetched client-side in one call to a new `POST /quote/v2/estimate-batch`, which runs each intent through the same code path as `/v2/estimate`.

**Tech Stack:** Node 20 · plain ES modules generator · vanilla browser JS (ES5 style, IIFE, no bundler) · Vitest + jsdom (`web-tests/unit`) · Playwright (`web-tests/e2e`) · Hono + Zod + Vitest in `api/`.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-21-trip-pages-redesign-design.md`
**Visual source of truth:** `docs/prototypes/trip-page-redesign.html` (approved mockup; the dark "Mockup" bar is not part of the design). Published copy: https://claude.ai/artifact/4hp7KNty4m8iM6zSfcEE36

## Global Constraints

- **One PR per Part (A–E). One branch each, cut from `origin/main` in a throwaway worktree** — never the shared checkout, never `git stash`, never `git add -A`:
  ```bash
  git fetch origin main
  git worktree add -b <branch> "$SCRATCHPAD/wt-<name>" origin/main
  ln -s /Users/roshenw/claude_code/ceylon-hop/web-tests/node_modules "$SCRATCHPAD/wt-<name>/web-tests/node_modules"
  ln -s /Users/roshenw/claude_code/ceylon-hop/api/node_modules "$SCRATCHPAD/wt-<name>/api/node_modules"
  ```
- **Generated output is never hand-edited.** Change the generator, then `npm run generate` from the repo root. If `main` moves under you: revert generated files, fast-forward, regenerate — never rebase/merge 52 generated files, never `git checkout --theirs` a stamped file.
- **Gates before every commit:** `cd api && npm run check` · `cd web-tests && npm run test:all` (must be run **from `web-tests/`**; includes Playwright; pass an explicit 600000 ms timeout; read the real exit code, not a pipe's) · `npm run generate` leaves no diff.
- **Do not touch:** `api/src/quote/rateCard.ts`, `departureRepo.ts`, migrations, `config.ts`/env, `site.css` (reuse its tokens only), `terms`/`privacy`/`404`.
- **Never point anything at `api/.env`'s `DATABASE_URL`** — it is prod.
- **SEO invariants (spec §3) hold in every PR:** titles, descriptions, H1 incl. `<span class="vh"> to </span>`, static fares/seat price/boarding times, JSON-LD catalogue-priced and equal to visible FAQ text, real `<a href>` for every route.
- **Hooks keep their meaning:** `data-live-fares`, `data-from-name`, `data-to-name`, `data-fare`, `.opt-private`, `.opt-cta`, `data-shared-cta`.
- **A shown fare never changes;** every engine failure ends silently at the catalogue figure in the markup.
- **Copy rules:** no airport meet-and-greet wording; traveller copy says "shared taxi"/"van" as today; Tripadvisor count only from `ta-data.js` (`TA.reviews`).
- Browser JS matches house style: `'use strict'` IIFE, `var`, no arrow functions, no optional chaining (see `route-page-fares.js`).
- E2E text-width assertions use line `Range`s, not height math; Linux fallback fonts are ~3.7% wider. `toBeEnabled()` misreads `aria-disabled`. Totals tween — assert with `toHaveText`, never a fixed wait.
- Engine fares cannot be verified on localhost (CORS allowlist). Verify on prod after the promote with `chEst:*` sessionStorage cleared.
- Commit trailer: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. PR body ends `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` and pastes red→green evidence.

## File Structure

| File | Responsibility | Part |
|---|---|---|
| `tools/place-photos.json` (new) | One entry per catalogue place + `_index`: file stem, alt, caption, credit, focal point, intrinsic size | A |
| `tools/place-photos.mjs` (new) | `loadPlacePhotos()`, `photoFor(id)`, `imgTag()` — fail loud on a missing entry/file | A |
| `img/places/<id>-900.jpg`, `-1800.jpg` (new) | The photos | A |
| `credits.html` | Credit rows for new Unsplash photos | A |
| `tools/generate-route-pages.mjs` | `routePage()` template + inline CSS (Part B); `tripIndex()` (Part C); list-fare hooks + head script (Part E) | B C E |
| `route-page-fares.js` | Stores both engine fares on the card; keeps CTA/price rule | B |
| `route-page-select.js` (new) | Vehicle radio → CTA `vehicle/price/rawPrice`; sticky mobile bar; nothing else | B |
| `route-page.js` | "Already going" rows: single-line, status pill copy | B |
| `trip-index.js` (new) | "Leaving from" chip filter (hide/show only) | C |
| `api/src/routes/quote.ts` | `POST /quote/v2/estimate-batch` | D |
| `route-list-fares.js` (new) | One batch ask → writes `[data-list-fare]` | E |
| `web-tests/unit/place-photos.test.js`, `trip-redesign.test.js`, `trip-index.test.js` (new) | Static-markup guards | A B C |
| `web-tests/e2e/route-page-select.spec.js`, `trip-index.spec.js`, `route-list-fares.spec.js` (new) | Behaviour | B C E |

`serve-booking.js` needs **no change**: it rewrites every live-API host to its own origin structurally, so the new path is already offline in e2e (this corrects spec §6.2's parenthetical).

### Task A1: Photo manifest loader

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/place-photos.mjs`, `tools/place-photos.json`
- Test: `web-tests/unit/place-photos.test.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `loadPlacePhotos(): Record<string, Photo>` where `Photo = { stem, alt, caption, credit, creditUrl, focal, w, h }`; `photoFor(photos, id): Photo` (throws `place-photos.json missing "<id>"`); `imgTag(photo, { p, sizes, eager, cls }): string`. Place ids are the catalogue ids that appear in a generated trip slug — verified 2026-09-21: `cmb-airport`, `colombo`, `negombo`, `kandy`, `sigiriya`, `nuwara-eliya`, `ella`, `galle`, `mirissa`, `yala`, `arugam-bay` — plus `_index`. (The catalogue's `byId` has 19 places; the other 8 have no trip page and need no photo. No id contains `-to-`, so splitting a slug on it is safe.)

```js
// web-tests/unit/place-photos.test.js

const photos = loadPlacePhotos();
// Only places a generated trip page names need a photo (the catalogue has 19 places; /trip/ uses 11).
const slugs = readdirSync(join(ROOT, 'trip'), { withFileTypes: true }).filter(d => d.isDirectory()).map(d => d.name);

  it.each(ids)('%s has a complete manifest entry', (id) => {
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the loader**

```js
// tools/place-photos.mjs
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';

const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

export function loadPlacePhotos() {
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(HERE, 'place-photos.json'), 'utf8'));
}

/** Fail loud, like route-content.json: a page with a hole where its photo goes must not generate. */
export function photoFor(photos, id) {
  const p = photos[id];
  if (!p) throw new Error(`place-photos.json missing "${id}"`);
  return p;
}

/** One <img>. `p` is the page's path back to the site root ('../../' on a route page). */
export function imgTag(photo, { p, sizes, eager = false, cls = '' }) {
  const base = `${p}img/places/${photo.stem}`;
  const h900 = Math.round(photo.h * 900 / photo.w);
  return `<img${cls ? ` class="${cls}"` : ''} src="${base}-900.jpg" srcset="${base}-900.jpg 900w, ${base}-1800.jpg 1800w" sizes="${sizes}" `
    + `width="900" height="${h900}" alt="${esc(photo.alt)}" style="object-position:${esc(photo.focal)}" `
    + (eager ? 'fetchpriority="high" decoding="async"' : 'loading="lazy" decoding="async"') + '>';
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Source the photos and write the manifest**

Reuse first (copy, don't move — other pages still use the originals):

| id | source |
|---|---|
| `ella` | `img/cta-nine-arch.jpg` |
| `sigiriya` | `img/tour-classic-hop.jpg` |
| `kandy` | pick from `img/tour-tea-and-trains*.jpg` / `about-train.jpg` — must read as Kandy/hill country, ≥1800 px wide; if none is ≥1800 px, source from Unsplash |
| `galle` | `img/tour-grand-island-loop.jpg` (check width; Unsplash if <1800) |
| `mirissa` | `img/tour-coast-honeymoon.jpg` (same check) |
| `yala` | `img/tour-wild-ceylon.jpg` (same check) |
| `cmb-airport`, `colombo`, `negombo`, `nuwara-eliya`, `arugam-bay`, `_index` | Unsplash (owner-approved 2026-09-21). Use the `mcp__unsplash__search_photos` tool; call `track_download` for each photo used. Landscape, no identifiable faces in close-up, no vehicles branded for another operator. |

Produce both widths (macOS `sips`; quality tuned so the 1800 is ≤ 250 KB):
```bash
mkdir -p img/places
sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 72 -Z 1800 <src> --out img/places/<stem>-1800.jpg
sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 72 -Z 900  <src> --out img/places/<stem>-900.jpg
```
`-Z` never upscales meaningfully for us: **reject any source narrower than 1800 px** instead of enlarging it.

Manifest entry shape (one per id; `w`/`h` are the 1800 file's real pixel size from `sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight`):
```json
{
  "ella": {
    "stem": "ella",
    "alt": "The blue hill-country train crossing Nine Arch Bridge near Ella",
    "caption": "Nine Arch Bridge, Ella",
    "credit": "Photographer Name",
    "creditUrl": "https://unsplash.com/photos/…",
    "focal": "50% 60%",
    "w": 1800, "h": 675
  }
}
```
For reused library photos, copy the credit/URL already listed for that file in `credits.html`. Add a `credits.html` row, in that page's existing row format, for every newly sourced photo.

```js
function faresCard(T, from, to, q, shared, p) {
  const bookHref = `${p}booking.html?${new URLSearchParams({
    from, to, mode: 'private', vehicle: 'car', price: String(q.car), rawPrice: String(q.rawCar),
  })}`;
  const tile = (v, name, cap, fare, checked) => `
        <label class="veh"><input type="radio" name="vehicle" value="${v}"${checked ? ' checked' : ''}>
          <span class="veh-ic" aria-hidden="true">${v === 'car' ? ICON_CAR : ICON_VAN}</span>
          <span class="veh-n">${name}<small>${cap}</small></span>
          <span class="veh-p"><span data-fare="${v}">$${price(fare)}</span><small>total, fixed</small></span></label>`;
  return `
      <article class="opt opt-private fares" data-live-fares data-from-name="${esc(T.byId[from].name)}" data-to-name="${esc(T.byId[to].name)}"
        data-cat-car="${q.car}" data-cat-van="${q.van}" data-raw-car="${q.rawCar}" data-raw-van="${q.rawVan}">
        <p class="fares-kick">Private transfer · door to door</p>
        <h2>Your own car, fixed price</h2>
        <fieldset class="veh-set"><legend class="vh">Choose a vehicle</legend>
          ${tile('car', 'AC car', 'up to 3 travellers + bags', q.car, true)}
          ${tile('van', 'AC van', 'up to 6 travellers + bags', q.van, false)}
        </fieldset>
        <a class="btn btn-cta opt-cta" href="${esc(bookHref)}">Choose date &amp; book</a>
        <p class="fares-fine">Free cancellation up to 24h before · no change fees</p>
        ${shared ? `<a class="share-strip" href="#share"><span>Or share the van<br><b>$${price(shared.seat)}</b> a seat</span><span>See who’s going ↓</span></a>` : ''}
      </article>`;
}
```

```js
/** First sentence of the intro, if it fits a hero line; otherwise a plain template. */
function pitch(intro, fromName, toName) {
  const first = (String(intro).match(/^.*?[.!?](?=\s|$)/) || [''])[0].trim();
  return first && first.length <= 120 ? first : `${fromName} to ${toName} in your own AC car or van, door to door, at a fixed price.`;
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `route-page-select.js`**

```js
/* ============================================================
   CEYLON HOP — route page: vehicle choice + mobile book bar
   ============================================================
   The fares card's two tiles are radios. Whichever is checked decides what the page's two
   booking links (the card's and the phone bar's) carry: vehicle, price, and — ONLY while the
   catalogue fare is what's showing — rawPrice. booking.js reads rawPrice FIRST, so it must
   never ride beside an engine fare (route-page-fares.js explains why).
   No JS → the static href books the car, exactly as generated.
   ============================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var card = document.querySelector('[data-live-fares]');
  if (!card) return;
  var bar = document.querySelector('.trip-bookbar');
  var links = [card.querySelector('a.opt-cta')];
  if (bar) links.push(bar.querySelector('a.bar-cta'));

  function chosen() {
    var r = card.querySelector('input[name=vehicle]:checked');
    return r ? r.value : 'car';
  }
  function sync() {
    var v = chosen();
    var cents = card.getAttribute('data-engine-' + v);
    links.forEach(function (a) {
      if (!a) return;
      var parts = a.getAttribute('href').split('?');
      var q = new URLSearchParams(parts[1] || '');
      q.set('vehicle', v);
      if (cents) { q.set('price', String(Number(cents) / 100)); q.delete('rawPrice'); }
      else { q.set('price', card.getAttribute('data-cat-' + v)); q.set('rawPrice', card.getAttribute('data-raw-' + v)); }
      a.setAttribute('href', parts[0] + '?' + q.toString());
    });
    if (bar) {
      bar.querySelector('[data-bar-label]').textContent = 'AC ' + v + ' · total, fixed';
      var fig = bar.querySelector('[data-fare]');
      fig.setAttribute('data-fare', v);
      fig.textContent = card.querySelector('.veh [data-fare="' + v + '"]').textContent;
    }
  }
  card.addEventListener('change', sync);
  card.addEventListener('ch:fares', sync);
  sync();

  if (bar && 'IntersectionObserver' in window && window.matchMedia('(max-width:900px)').matches) {
    new IntersectionObserver(function (e) { bar.hidden = e[0].isIntersecting; }, { threshold: 0 }).observe(card);
  }
})();
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

```js
/* CEYLON HOP — /trip/ index: "Leaving from" filter. Hides origin blocks; never removes a link.
   Without this file the chips are plain in-page anchors, which is the no-JS behaviour. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var chips = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.fchips [data-from]'));
  var blocks = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('section.origin'));
  if (!chips.length) return;
  chips.forEach(function (chip) {
    chip.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(chip.getAttribute('data-from') === ''));
    chip.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var k = chip.getAttribute('data-from');
      chips.forEach(function (c) { c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(c === chip)); });
      blocks.forEach(function (b) { b.hidden = !!k && b.getAttribute('data-origin') !== k; });
    });
  });
})();
```

# Part D — `POST /quote/v2/estimate-batch` (PR 4, branch `feat/estimate-batch`, independent)

⚠ Interface addition — owner approved via the spec (2026-09-21). No schema, migration, pricing or config change. Merging deploys to **staging**; prod only on promote.

**Distance-cost finding (resolves spec §6.1's open check):** `engineRequestFor` → `maps.distance()`; prod wraps the adapter in `CachedMapsAdapter`, which persists every non-estimated **catalogue-town** pair to `distance_cache`. So a catalogue pair costs at most one billed Google call ever. The batch therefore accepts **only** legs where both ends satisfy `isCatalogTown()`; everything else is `null`. No extra in-memory cache needed.

### Task D1: The endpoint

**Files:** Modify `api/src/routes/quote.ts` (add after the `/v2/estimate` handler, ~line 290); Test: `api/src/routes/quote.test.ts` (new `describe` after "public quote v2 estimate").

**Interfaces:** Produces `POST /quote/v2/estimate-batch` · body `{ intents: WebQuoteIntent[] }` (1–60) · `200 { results: ({ totalCents: number, currency: string } | null)[] }` index-aligned · `400 invalid_request` on a malformed envelope or >60 · `404` when v2 is off · `501` with no maps adapter.

```ts
  const intent = (from: string, to: string, vehicle: 'car' | 'van' = 'car') =>
    ({ vehicle, product: 'private', pax: 1, bags: 0, legs: [{ from, to }], extras: [] });

  it('prices every intent, index-aligned, and persists nothing', async () => {
    const { app, quotes } = batchApp();
    const res = await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', { intents: [intent('Kandy', 'Ella'), intent('Galle', 'Mirissa', 'van')] });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const { results } = await res.json();
    expect(results).toHaveLength(2);

    expect(results[0].currency).toBe('USD');
    expect(results[1].totalCents).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(await quotes.list()).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('gives exactly the figure /v2/estimate gives for the same intent', async () => {
    const { app } = batchApp();
    const one = await (await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate', intent('Kandy', 'Ella'))).json();
    const { results } = await (await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', { intents: [intent('Kandy', 'Ella')] })).json();
    expect(results[0].totalCents).toBe(one.totalCents);
  });

  it('nulls one bad intent without failing its neighbours', async () => {
    const { app } = batchApp();
    const { results } = await (await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', {
      intents: [intent('Kandy', 'Ella'), { nonsense: true }, intent('Kandy', '12 Some Hotel Lane, Nowhere'), intent('Galle', 'Mirissa')],
    })).json();
    expect(results[0]).not.toBeNull();
    expect(results[1]).toBeNull();
    expect(results[2]).toBeNull(); // not a catalogue town → never reaches the maps adapter
    expect(results[3]).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('never asks the maps adapter about a non-catalogue place', async () => {
    const inner = new FakeMapsAdapter();
    const asked: string[] = [];
    const spy: MapsAdapter = { ...inner, provider: inner.provider, places: (q) => inner.places(q),
      distance: (a, b) => { asked.push(`${a}|${b}`); return inner.distance(a, b); } } as MapsAdapter;
    const { app } = batchApp(spy);
    await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', { intents: [intent('Kandy', '12 Some Hotel Lane, Nowhere')] });
    expect(asked).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('nulls an estimated distance rather than advertising a price built on one', async () => {
    const inner = new FakeMapsAdapter();
    const est: MapsAdapter = { ...inner, provider: inner.provider, places: (q) => inner.places(q),
      distance: async () => ({ km: 140, durationMin: 230, estimated: true }) } as MapsAdapter;
    const { app } = batchApp(est);
    const { results } = await (await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', { intents: [intent('Kandy', 'Ella')] })).json();
    expect(results[0]).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses an empty batch, more than 60 intents, and a non-object body', async () => {
    const { app } = batchApp();
    expect((await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', { intents: [] })).status).toBe(400);
    expect((await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', { intents: Array.from({ length: 61 }, () => intent('Kandy', 'Ella')) })).status).toBe(400);
    expect((await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', 'nope')).status).toBe(400);
  });

  it('is 404 when v2 is disabled', async () => {
    const app = createApp({ quotes: new InMemoryQuoteRepo() });
    expect((await post(app as never, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', { intents: [intent('Kandy', 'Ella')] })).status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('never leaks margin or line items', async () => {
    const { app } = batchApp();
    const { results } = await (await post(app, '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', { intents: [intent('Kandy', 'Ella')] })).json();
    expect(Object.keys(results[0]).sort()).toEqual(['currency', 'totalCents']);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

```ts
  // Many list prices in ONE request (spec 2026-09-21 §6.1): the /trip/ index and "where next"
  // cards advertise the engine's fare, and ch-pricing can only ask one intent at a time.
  // Each intent takes the SAME path as /v2/estimate — engineRequestFor → quote() on the live card —
  // so a list price and the page it links to cannot disagree. Two deliberate differences:
  //   • only catalogue-town legs are priced. Those are the pairs CachedMapsAdapter persists, so a
  //     batch costs at most one billed distance call per pair, EVER. Anything else is null — this
  //     endpoint must not become a way to fan 60 arbitrary addresses out to Google.
  //   • an estimated distance is null, not flagged: a list has nowhere to put the caveat.
  // One bad intent never fails the batch; the page keeps its catalogue figure for that row.
  const BatchSchema = z.object({ intents: z.array(z.unknown()).min(1).max(60) }).strict();
  r.post('/v2/estimate-batch', async (c) => {
    if (!deps.v2Enabled) return c.notFound();
    if (!deps.maps) return c.json({ error: 'not_available' }, 501);
    const envelope = BatchSchema.safeParse(await c.req.json().catch(() => null));
    if (!envelope.success) return c.json({ error: 'invalid_request', details: envelope.error.flatten() }, 400);
    const maps = deps.maps;
    const card = await liveCard();
    const results = await Promise.all(envelope.data.intents.map(async (raw) => {
      try {
        const parsed = WebQuoteIntentSchema.safeParse(raw);
        if (!parsed.success || parsed.data.product !== 'private') return null;
        if (!parsed.data.legs.every((l) => isCatalogTown(l.from) && isCatalogTown(l.to))) return null;
        const resolved = await engineRequestFor(parsed.data, maps);
        if (!resolved || resolved.estimated) return null;
        const result = quote(resolved.request, card);
        return { totalCents: result.totalCents, currency: result.currency };
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }));
    return c.json({ results }, 200);
  });
```

Confirm the engine result's currency field name (`grep -n "currency" api/src/quote/types.ts`); if the result carries no currency, return the rate card's and keep the test's `'USD'` expectation. If `isCatalogTown` does not accept the display names the pages send ("Colombo Airport (CMB)", "Sigiriya / Dambulla"), that is what `canonPlace` is for — check `isCatalogTown`'s body; add one test per awkward name rather than assuming.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

```js
/* ============================================================
   CEYLON HOP — list fares
   ============================================================
   A LIST price advertises the engine's fare too (spec 2026-09-21 §6). The /trip/ index and
   the "where next" cards bake the catalogue fare; the page each one links to shows the
   engine's (hot zones live in the prod DB). Kandy → Ella read $59.99 here, $66 there.

   ch-pricing.js tracks one intent at a time, so a list cannot use it. This asks
   POST /quote/v2/estimate-batch ONCE for every distinct pair on the page — car fares, the
   "from" price — and writes the answers in.

   Same rules as route-page-fares.js: the <head> sets `list-fares-pending` before first paint
   (figures held transparent, in place) and releases it on its own timer; a fare that has been
   SHOWN never changes, so an answer later than CAP_MS is dropped; and every failure — no API,
   ?api=off, 404, a null row, a network error, this file not loading — ends at the catalogue
   figure already in the markup. Silently.
   ============================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var CAP_MS = 4000;
  var root = document.documentElement;
  function release() { root.classList.remove('list-fares-pending'); }

  var els = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-list-fare][data-from-name][data-to-name]'));
  if (!els.length || !window.CEYLON_HOP_API || !window.fetch) return release();

  var keys = [], intents = [];
  els.forEach(function (el) {
    var from = el.getAttribute('data-from-name'), to = el.getAttribute('data-to-name');
    var k = from + '|' + to;
    if (keys.indexOf(k) !== -1) return;
    keys.push(k);
    // Key order is search.js's and route-page-fares.js's. Keep it.
    intents.push({ vehicle: 'car', product: 'private', pax: 1, bags: 0, legs: [{ from: from, to: to }], extras: [] });
  });

  var settled = false;
  var cap = setTimeout(function () { settled = true; release(); }, CAP_MS);
  function money(cents) { return '$' + (cents % 100 === 0 ? String(cents / 100) : (cents / 100).toFixed(2)); }

  fetch(window.CEYLON_HOP_API.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/quote/v2/estimate-batch', {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ intents: intents })
  }).then(function (res) { return res.ok ? res.json() : null; }).then(function (body) {
    if (settled) return;                      // the cap already showed the catalogue fares
    settled = true;
    clearTimeout(cap);
    var results = body && body.results;
    if (results && results.length === keys.length) {
      els.forEach(function (el) {
        var r = results[keys.indexOf(el.getAttribute('data-from-name') + '|' + el.getAttribute('data-to-name'))];
        if (r && typeof r.totalCents === 'number') el.textContent = money(r.totalCents);
      });
    }
    release();
  }).catch(function () { if (!settled) { settled = true; clearTimeout(cap); release(); } });
})();
```
Head block (both templates), beside the existing `fares-pending` line:
`d.classList.add('list-fares-pending');setTimeout(function(){d.classList.remove('list-fares-pending');},4500);`
More than 60 distinct pairs is impossible today (44 on the index); if `intents.length > 60`, send the first 60 and leave the rest catalogue — add that slice and a unit assertion that the index has ≤ 60 distinct pairs, so growth fails a test rather than a request.
